program.name: Posture Long
program.subject: Mobility & posture
program.blurb: Long posture sessions: the upper back and neck, then the hips and spine.
program.about: For standing and sitting taller. One day opens the chest and strengthens the upper back and neck with circuits of Y raises, snow angels and chin tucks; the other frees the hips and spine with flows and a glute circuit. They alternate. Both later levels add reps.
program.split: Upper back & neck / hips & spine, long
